title: Bank of Queensland Limited - proposed acquisition of Mackay Permanent Building Society

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Market definition: In any market for banking and/or insurance service, however defined, no substantial lessening of competition is likely due to competition from many other players of various sizes, particularly given the minimal increment in market share as a result of the transaction.
